C1084.title: Ruichang Court: Is Pulling People into Groups Illegal? Two Men Sentenced for Adding Members to Groups
C1084.summary: In April 2020, defendants Zhang and Jin illegally established a network technology company and hired employees. From March to April 2021, they organized staff to impersonate securities firm employees and pull potential stock investors into WeChat groups set up by fraudsters, providing WeChat traffic-generation services for the fraud operation. They obtained 219,788.36 yuan in illegal referral fees. The court convicted both of aiding information network criminal activities, sentencing each to eight months in prison and a 20,000 yuan fine.
